messages.author: b5f242e7eb90c7c9
messages.subject: Error related to removeEmptyRows=TRUE
parts:
Dear all,

I am new to multilevel IRT. I am analyzing a course evaluation dataset. The data is multilevel (students within class). I tried the mixedmirt command, but R showed the following error message:

model <- 'instructor = 1-7
          course = 8-15'

mixedmirt(data=maindata, model=model, covdata=covariate, fixed = ~1, random = ~1|CourseID2,
          itemtype = 'Rasch',  technical = list(removeEmptyRows = TRUE))

Error: data contains completely empty response patterns.Please remove manually or pass removeEmptyRows=TRUE to the technical list

I am unsure why I get this error. The variable CourseID2 is found in the dataset called 'covariate'. Any help will be very useful!

Thanks,
Chester
